page.notes: The text runs on at the foot: "sim-" is a printed hyphen, with the rest of the word "plex," as catchword. Doubtful readings: "subiecta" (the word is partly run together in the scan), "idé" (accent as printed, possibly an abbreviation), "decostuq;" (read as decoctuq;, uncertain). The s in subiecta and decostuq is an uncertain letter in the scan.
